title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-04-11

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording captures a spirited but uneven April 11 1970 Fillmore West show, with an electrifying Love Light that many reviewers adore despite one lukewarm take.
ai_review.review: The SBD source delivers clear, well‑balanced audio for its era and lets listeners hear the raw energy of Pigpen’s “Love Light” – a highlight praised by most reviewers. While several fans describe the performance as a punchy, wild showcase with great harmonies and Bobby’s ecstatic playing, one reviewer felt the band never really got off the ground, giving the show a mixed overall impression.

ai_rating.rationale: Four of five reviewers give 4‑5 stars and praise both the performance (especially Love Light) and the recording quality; one reviewer is critical, pulling the average down slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear for a 1970 SBD tape with a well‑balanced mix; some mention of an out‑of‑tune fade at the start and occasional era‑specific muddiness, but overall praised as excellent for its time.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is anchored by a powerful Love Light that builds from a sloppy intro into a wild jam; reviewers note strong Pigpen vocals, tight harmonies on Shine On Me, and an overall energetic if uneven flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Only briefly mentioned (Bobby hollering at Garcia), no specific praise or criticism of his guitar work.
band_member_comments.Bob: Pigpen’s vocals and stage antics are highlighted as “bad‑ass” and the driving force behind the performance; Bobby goes “nuts” toward the end.
band_member_comments.Drums: Crashing cymbals receive positive mention for adding excitement.
